en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a Baroque urban square. In the foreground there is a low stone wall with iron railings and flower beds. Behind it stand ornate historic buildings with stucco decorations and shuttered windows. To the right is a richly decorated church façade with statues and a curved gable, and in the distance a slender church tower with an onion dome rises above the rooftops. The bottom margin contains handwritten German text identifying the location and a small photographer's signature.
